name: xr3_beatup_sub
purpose: Beat Up into a Substitute, each hit gated on its own (multihit = the six members, data/moves.ts:1150-1170; each hit is one spreadMoveHit, so the sub takes the first hit that reaches it and the later hits go on to the target): Krookodile (M) hits Gengar (M), whose sub is up from turn 1 (Gengar is faster). Dark is super effective on Gengar, so the sub breaks within the hits. Beat Up is not bypasssub.
